snippet.title: EDGamesExpo21.Looking inside – Cells by NYU CREATE
snippet.description:
Looking Inside - Cells is a Collaborative VR Learning Environment for Middle School Science, available for free. Students work in small groups to design cells, learn about mitosis, and learn about cell specialization. Designed and developed by NYU CREATE and the NYU Future Reality Lab.

Download: http://create.nyu.edu/downloads (Use Access Code EdGamesExpo)

More information: https://steinhardt.nyu.edu/create/research/looking-inside

Questions: create.research@nyu.edu 

Developed by New York University’s CREATE Lab and Future Reality Lab with partial support from a 2016 NSF MRI award to New York University.
